scope: Priority 2 — Apktool security advisory verification on existing Ubuntu Linux VPS
user_decision: Do not update Apktool yet; preserve installed Ubuntu package and REA runtime

observation.diagnostic: Upstream-version-only precaution for CVE-2024-21633; it cannot identify Ubuntu/Debian backported fixes.

patch_evidence.changelog_entry: apktool (2.7.0+dfsg-7): CVE-2024-21633: Prevent arbitrary file writes with malicious resource names. (10 Jan 2024)
patch_evidence.deployed_bytecode: ResFileDecoder.decode invokes brut.util.BrutIO.detectPossibleDirectoryTraversal; BrutIO method verified via javap disassembly. Unknown-file path checks also present.

decision.risk_assessment: The specific CVE-2024-21633 is patched in the installed distro build; the REA warning is a conservative upstream-version-only warning, not evidence that this package is vulnerable.
decision.action: Close priority 2 security concern with evidence; keep existing warning unchanged rather than weaken generic protection for unknown vulnerable Apktool builds.

limitations: This attests to the distro backport of CVE-2024-21633 only; it is not a general assurance against other Apktool issues.
It does not establish decode/rebuild functionality on an Android APK; that is a distinct functional test.
The version-only warning may still be displayed by REA and should not be hidden for unidentified installations.
